Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk Training Page

This page covers companion animal bookings and arrival handoff, because both steps shape animal safety, passenger trust, and on-time ground work. New staff must handle these records with care, keep communication direct, and pass complete details to the cabin team and the receiving station without delay. The Companion Animal Travel Desk supports travelers with pets from request to arrival, so accuracy here protects the animal and the schedule.

For booking, submit the request 84 hours before departure and verify that the traveler name, flight details, and animal profile match the reservation record. Keep the tone calm and respectful when you speak with the passenger, and confirm any crate, feeding, or documentation notes before you forward the file. If a traveler such as Yara Khan or Sana Moretti calls with a change, record the update at once and check the revised details against the rest of the case.

For arrival pickup, use FM-394 with the release packet before the animal is handed over. Match the form to the flight record, confirm the collecting party, and check that the handoff location is clear to the station team. If Millie is listed on a file, treat the record the same way as any other companion animal case: confirm identity, review the paperwork, and keep the pickup sequence tidy. The cabin team monitors animals during flight, so your job on the ground is to keep the information chain clean from booking through collection.

If a document is missing, pause the release, notify the supervisor, and wait for corrected paperwork. Do not improvise on identifiers or handoff notes, and do not leave a file open without a clear status. Prompt and respectful communication prevents confusion, reduces delay, and keeps Aurelia Skyways aligned with passenger expectations.

Remember the deadline, the form, and the handoff steps, and keep every companion animal file precise from start to finish.
